name: Working Too Much
overview: Scripture warns against excessive labor that leads to weariness and sorrow, reminding believers that God grants rest to His beloved, as seen in Psalms 127:2. The pursuit of work for envy or worldly gain is ultimately vain and frustrating, reflecting the vanity described in Ecclesiastes 4:4. True diligence is marked by doing all things heartily as unto the Lord (Colossians 3:23), seeking His will rather than our own (John 5:30), and bearing fruit through understanding His word (Matthew 13:23). Believers are cautioned to avoid being misled by worldly philosophies that distract from Christ-centered living (Colossians 2:8).
